name: parallelbrowser
description: ParallelBrowser - Remote isolated browser access system

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix host-app && npm install --prefix client-app
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:host && npm run build:client
scripts.dist:host: npm run build:shared && npm run build:host && npm run dist --prefix host-app
scripts.dist:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build:client && npm run dist --prefix client-app
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:host && npm run dist:client
